senses.gloss:
neti
------------------------------------------
Works on हठयोग like the Gheraṇḍa Saṁhitā describe certain processes of cleansing the body internally, to make it healthy and strong so that it becomes fit for sādhanā or spiritual practice. These are generally grouped under one title, the ‘Ṣaṭkarmas’, or the ‘six processes’. नेति is one of them and the third in the list.
It is performed by inserting a thin thread of soft cotton, about 6 inches long, into the nostrils, passing it through and pulling it out by the mouth (Gheraṇḍa Saṁhitā 1.50).
Of course, this has to be done under expert supervision.
See also ṢAṬKARMAS.
